name: Canasta
summary: Partnership rummy game where teams meld same-rank sets to build seven-card canastas.
rules_text: Four players in two fixed partnerships opposite each other use two decks with jokers. Deuces and jokers are wild but can only be melded with natural cards, max three wilds per meld and at least two naturals. Deal 11 cards each, remainder is stock, turn up one card. Red threes are bonus cards laid immediately for a replacement. On a turn draw top of stock or take discard pile if top card fits a meld you have or can make with a natural pair or natural+wild from hand, then take whole pile. You may then meld sets of 3+ same rank. Seven cards with at least four naturals is a canasta, pure if no wilds. First meld of side must meet point minimum based on total score. Discard pile is frozen by wilds, black threes or before initial meld and can only be taken with natural pair. Side must have a canasta to go out. Scoring counts card points plus canasta and red three bonuses minus hand cards.
rating_reason: Specific rummy partnership game with hidden hands and melding strategy
